arguments.value: Xi'an Zhonghong New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. and Boxing County Chengli Gas Supply Co., Ltd. entered into a July 2013 cooperation agreement for a CDQ (coke dry quenching) and CDQ waste heat power generation project at Boxing County Chengli Gas Supply Co., Ltd.'s site. Xi'an Zhonghong New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. will fund, design, build, operate, and maintain the project, while Boxing County Chengli Gas Supply Co., Ltd. will provide the land, support permits and approvals, supply qualified coal coke and utilities, and buy all electricity generated. The project is a BO model with an expected cost of RMB 176 million, a 12-month construction period, a 20-year term, and payment based on electricity output at agreed rates, with adjustments if the grid electricity price changes. The agreement also sets rules for metering, quality, ownership and intellectual property, sharing of government incentives, breach penalties, force majeure, dispute resolution, and termination. The source does not state any governing law.
